_comment: Runtime plugin dependencies for android-foundation, aggregated by pipeline-orchestrator Step 0a. Every skill listed here is MANDATED by this plugin's own manifest.yaml `role_expertise.<role>.skills` rows — that block is the mapping, and each entry is traceable to a role (ADR-0021: this plugin ships no agents, so there is no agent file to trace to any more). `sdlc-lint roster` enforces the tie for superpowers:* rows. Android CLI is a SYSTEM tool, not a plugin: it is checked entirely inside android-foundation (hooks/android-cli-check.sh), never by the core, so it does not belong here. Detection is marketplace-agnostic: deps.mjs keys skills on the bare plugin name (pluginNameOf), so ANY install of superpowers satisfies this row — superpowers@claude-plugins-official, superpowers@superpowers-dev (obra's own dev marketplace), or a user-level skills/ copy. install_command names the RECOMMENDED source, not a requirement. This marketplace deliberately does not re-declare superpowers as an entry of its own (ADR-0028): doing so clones it into our namespace as superpowers@agentic-sdlc and shadows the user's real install.

dependencies.name: superpowers
dependencies.fallback_note: The pipeline still runs, with reduced rigor: the business-analyst formulates requirements without a structured brainstorm, developer and tester write code without the TDD discipline, reviewer and debugger lose their review and root-cause methodologies, and no role runs the pre-handoff verification pass.

dependencies.name: frontend-design
dependencies.fallback_note: The developer role implements Compose screens without the visual-design pass; layout, spacing and hierarchy get no dedicated review before the code review sees them.
